data.name: Rahi
data.gender_notes: Rahi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides and travels, a traveler or a guide. The name Rahi carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rahi usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual guide, a companion on the journey of life
data.etymology: Rahi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رحى
in_arabic.meaning: اسم رحى يعني سريع النقل أو المُتحرك
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم رحى مشتق من الجذر ر ح ي يضم المعاني المتعلقة بالحركة والانتقال، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، ويُعتبر من أسماء النبي إسماعيل، ويُرمز للحركة والنشاط، ويُستخدم في تسمية الأطفال في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: رحى
in_urdu.meaning: اسم رحى کے معنی ہیں سريع نقل یا متحرک
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم رحى کا تعلق الجذر ر ح ی سے ہے جس میں حرکیات اور انتقالیات کے معنی شامل ہیں، یہ قرآن میں اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک حسن منزلتاں والا نام ہے، اسی طرح یہ پہلوان اسلام نبی اسماعیل علیہ السلام کا نام بھی ہے، اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے کہ وہ بہت تیزی سے چلنے والا اور حرکت کرنے والا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں پیدائش کے موقع پر بچوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रही
in_hindi.meaning: नाम राही का अर्थ है तेज गति वाला या गतिशील
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम राही का मूल अर्थ है गति और परिवर्तन, यह नाम गुरु ग्रंथ साहिब में प्रकाशित हुआ है, यह नाम नबी इब्राहिम के वंशजों में से एक नबी इस्माइल का भी नाम है, इसका अर्थ है गति और गतिशीलता से जुड़ा हुआ है, इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बच्चों के लिए पैदा होने पर किया जाता है

in_english.name: Rahi
in_english.meaning: The name Rahi means swift or moving entity, often associated with speed and agility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahi is derived from the Arabic root R-H-Y, which encompasses meanings related to movement and transition. It is also one of the beautiful names of Allah in the Quran, and is associated with the Prophet Ishmael. It symbolizes movement and activity, and is used in some Islamic cultures to name children at birth. In Arabic, the name Rahi is often used to describe something or someone that is swift or moving, and it is also used to describe the movement of the heart, which is considered a sign of spiritual growth and development.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rahi holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community as it is associated with the concept of being a guide and a helper to others. In Islamic lore, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is often referred to as "Al-Rahman Al-Rahim," meaning "The Most Merciful, The Most Compassionate." This name emphasizes God's nature as a guide and caretaker of His creation. Rahi, as a name, can be seen as a reflection of this divine attribute, inspiring the bearer to embody the qualities of a helpful and compassionate person.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rahi carries a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it reminds the bearer of their role as a guide and helper to others in their community. It inspires them to provide guidance and support when needed, emulating the kindness and compassion of God. The name Rahi also serves as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) role as a guide for Muslims, encouraging the bearer to follow his teachings and strive towards living a virtuous life. Ultimately, the name Rhai is a reflection of the Islamic values of compassion, generosity, and care for others, inspiring the bearer to live a fulfilling and purposeful life.
